Hi team,

BrioHealth verbally signed yesterday and asked for a soft start the week of Apr 3. They are small but time-sensitive — want production traffic by end of April for a pilot. Quick summary below to orient CS/implementation: 

Deal context
- ACV: $120k first-year (usage + hosting)
- Product: hosted inference (chat + embeddings) + dedicated burst for peak hours
- Key success metric: <150ms 95th token latency for chat flows under typical user mix

Customer contacts
- Sanjay Rao, Head of ML (technical lead)
- Elena Morales, Director of Product (PM/approval)

Technical notes / requirements
- We need to provision dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) and enable prefix caching for their nightly batch queries.
- They will send a subset of golden prompt sets for eval — Sanjay will share by Fri (Mar 24).
- Data retention: 90 days rolling; they asked about S3 logs export.

Open items for CS/Implementation
1) SOW finalization (legal redlines in attached PDF) — Finance needs sign-off before provisioning.
2) Preliminary runbook & timeline — I attached a runbook template and initial MAP.
3) Kickoff meeting — customer requested the week of Mar 27 to align on milestones; prefer Wed or Thu.

Owner ask
- Tessa: would you take PM ownership of the activation? Recommend a CS owner + Implementation engineer pairing.
- Marissa: can you confirm resource availability for Apr 3 soft start and an initial 2-week hypercare window?
- Ben: please add the dedicated capacity request into the capacity tracker and flag any conflicts.

I've attached the MAP and SOW draft for reference. I also left the HubSpot deal notes up-to-date (link below).

Thanks — Jordan

--
